other_methods.principle: Records identified through routes other than the database search, as PRISMA-ScR reports them: known before the search, professional or methodological guidance, citations and author searches from an included report, the audit sample of the unscreened remainder, or not recorded.

deduplication.rule: DOI, else PMID, else normalised title (ASCII-folded, alphanumeric only)
deduplication.known_defect: build_pool.py keyed PubMed records by the last DOI in the record, which can be a cited reference; some merges are therefore wrong and some report ids in the pool are not the report's own. The ledger keys reports by verified identifiers; the pool is to be rebuilt in a separate correction.

audit_of_unscreened.interpretation: The priority ordering is not a complete screen. An estimated share of eligible records sits below the threshold and was never screened. Most of them are transfer-layer NLP method papers, a large and well-populated literature; two of the six clear finds were direct or requirements evidence, so the gap is not confined to the transfer layer.
audit_of_unscreened.basis: recorded in screening-decisions.json; the sample on disk was regenerated after the parser fix (see reports.json diagnostics)

inclusion.basis: reports.json inclusion blocks, which record the local catalog; no human inclusion decision exists

synthesis.note: Families are the investigator's provisional organising device, not validated dimensions.
synthesis.basis: candidates, families, methods, levels, blind spots and pilot entries are recorded from the local catalog; the source counts are derived from reports.json

caveat: Counts describe what was executed. The 9579 unscreened records and the two unsearched databases mean this is not a completed scoping review and must not be reported as one.

corrections.what: BibTeX parser in acl_search.py appended uncollected field lines (pages, isbn) to the preceding collected field, corrupting 1886 of 10066 recorded DOIs.
corrections.found_by: auditing the pool before committing, not by a failing test
corrections.effect: 7 records that should have merged did not. Unique records 10066 -> 10059, duplicates removed 1296 -> 1303. Query hit counts and screening set unchanged.
corrections.also: DOI fields are now normalised at both ingest sites, which removed a Google Scholar session token that a PubMed record carried inside its doi ArticleId.

corrections.what: Screening decisions were recorded as positions in the priority ordering.
corrections.effect: The parser fix left the 487-record priority set identical but moved 29 positions. Decisions are now keyed by record title in include-candidates.json and screen.py resolves them, so a re-run cannot silently reassign a decision to another record.

corrections.what: The flow reported identification only from the database search; the sources that entered through other routes (known sources, professional guidance, citations) were not shown as such, and the synthesis counts predated the additions of 2026-09-13 (K28, K29, ME17, one assessment level, one blind spot, P13, P14).
corrections.effect: other_methods block added; full_text counts include the two guidance documents now logged; synthesis counts recomputed from the registry.

corrections.what: flow-v1 counted retrieval attempts as reports, listed Keren 2026 (S19) as not retrieved after its PDF had been logged, showed S4 under search and screening although it is not in the pool, carried two retrieved rows without file or checksum, and never recorded that S15-S17 were retrieved.
corrections.effect: flow.json is generated by build_flow.py from reports.json and the search, pool, screening and amendment records: full text is counted at report level (19 sought, 18 retrieved, 1 not retrieved) with attempts reported separately; the other-methods block is derived from the routes in the ledger; hand edits fail the suite.
